profile.description: SEAMLESS standard scenario assumption profile: conditions safe Active Directory intranet reachability, protocol acceptance, and DACL write rights while strictly forbidding recovery_success, unverified distribution groups, and fictitious edges.

rules.rationale: Domain Controllers (KDCs) are network-reachable on port 88 within intranet
MS-RPC port 135/dynamic RPC reachable for directory/SAMR operations
WinRM ports 5985/5986 reachable to servers configured for remote management
WinRM service is running and listening on target computer
KDC standard AS-REQ accepted for accounts with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH flag
KDC standard TGS-REQ accepted for accounts with valid SPN
Kerberos authentication package is functional on domain member systems
Authenticated logon session holds a valid Kerberos TGT
Administrative channel (SMB/WMI/WinRM) is available for local administrators
Host execution context permits remote code execution for administrators
Target endpoint authorizes connections from designated administrator accounts
Local administrator group mapping corresponds to AdminTo entitlement
Target validates and accepts valid domain credentials
WinRM listener validates and accepts administrative credentials
Remote Desktop service is enabled and accepting connections
WinRM PowerShell remoting endpoint is available
Active Directory directory modification allowed under granted ACE rights
Password reset value satisfies domain password complexity and length policy
Modifying group member attribute allowed under granted object control ACE
Group SID is incorporated into access token upon session logon
Target account secret is current, unexpired, and matches directory password hash
Target group is a security-enabled group capable of token authorization

profile.description: SEAMLESS standard scenario assumption profile: conditions safe Active Directory intranet reachability, protocol acceptance, and DACL write rights while strictly forbidding recovery_success, unverified distribution groups, and fictitious edges.

rules.rationale: Domain Controllers (KDCs) are network-reachable on port 88 within intranet
MS-RPC port 135/dynamic RPC reachable for directory/SAMR operations
WinRM ports 5985/5986 reachable to servers configured for remote management
WinRM service is running and listening on target computer
KDC standard AS-REQ accepted for accounts with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH flag
KDC standard TGS-REQ accepted for accounts with valid SPN
Kerberos authentication package is functional on domain member systems
Authenticated logon session holds a valid Kerberos TGT
Administrative channel (SMB/WMI/WinRM) is available for local administrators
Host execution context permits remote code execution for administrators
Target endpoint authorizes connections from designated administrator accounts
Local administrator group mapping corresponds to AdminTo entitlement
Target validates and accepts valid domain credentials
WinRM listener validates and accepts administrative credentials
Remote Desktop service is enabled and accepting connections
WinRM PowerShell remoting endpoint is available
Active Directory directory modification allowed under granted ACE rights
Password reset value satisfies domain password complexity and length policy
Modifying group member attribute allowed under granted object control ACE
Group SID is incorporated into access token upon session logon
Target account secret is current, unexpired, and matches directory password hash
Target group is a security-enabled group capable of token authorization

summary.search_strategy: Existing per-source/per-goal planner; prepared reuse, not shared traversal
